summary: Frontend-only testing of CatatAgen Expo web preview at 390x844 for 2 new features: (1) Edit riwayat transaksi and (2) Most-used chips/templates appear first. All 10 feature groups PASSED. Edit flow (navigate from Riwayat pencil -> Input tab, prefill, 'Edit Transaksi' title, 'Simpan Perubahan' label, template button hidden, edit-banner visible, cancel resets, no duplicate on save, toast 'Perubahan transaksi disimpan') verified for both transfer and PPOB types. Frequency sorting verified: nominal chips sorted by per-type usage, custom nominal (75000) appears as chip after use, bank chips sorted by usage count (DANA before BCA), kategori-chip for PPOB sorted (Token PLN first), templates sorted by matching tx count. Regression (add/delete/filter counts) still works.

issues: Console warn: 'shadow*' style props deprecated, prefer 'boxShadow' (RN Web). Non-blocking.
Console warn: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (likely from Animated.View toast in src/store.tsx:158). Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: in src/store.tsx replace Animated.View pointerEvents="none" prop with style={{pointerEvents:'none', ...}} to silence RN Web warning.
Optional: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow across ui components.
critical_code_review_comments: Edit flow in index.tsx uses router.setParams({edit:''}) to exit. Works, but a repeat-edit of the same tx id after an in-session cancel can occasionally not re-trigger the useEffect because dep is editing?.id (same id). Observed once in a long combined flow; could not reproduce in isolation. Safer: include edit search-param itself as dep, or key the Card by edit id.
byFrequency ties preserve default order (good). Nominal chips capped to 8 via slice (verified). Templates sorted by tplKey match count (type|nominal|bank or ppob|kategori|produk lower-cased).
updateTx in store.tsx preserves id and keeps order via map (no duplicate) - verified: tx count unchanged after edit-save.
All interactive elements expose testID (tx-edit-*, edit-banner, edit-cancel-button, save-transaction-button, template-apply-*, nominal-chip-*, bank-chip-*, kategori-chip-*, filter-*).
seed_data_creation: Transient in-session: 3 Transfer 500k DANA, 2 Transfer 200k BCA, 2 custom-nominal 75000 DANA, 3 PPOB Token PLN, 2 templates. Cleared via localStorage.removeItem before each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AsyncStorage web uses localStorage with 'catatagen.*' keys; clear via localStorage.removeItem then reload. nominal-input is MoneyInput: page.fill with digits accepted. tx-edit-<id> pencil button in Riwayat navigates to '/' with ?edit=<id>; useLocalSearchParams drives edit mode via useEffect on editing?.id. If testing edit->cancel->edit-same-id sequences in one script run, the useEffect may not refire due to same dep id - either edit a different tx or reload between.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no new bugs. One flakiness noted in context_for_next_testing_agent.
